truthRule: Every screenshot-derived claim is a research/architecture input, not a verified fact or live capability. Verify time-sensitive claims before implementation.

insights.title: Governed AI command/capability registry
insights.notes: Convert prompt-code ideas into typed intents routed through capabilities, permissions, risk lanes and evidence rules.

insights.title: Reusable reasoning and professional work modes
insights.notes: Implement as governed templates/workflows, not magic secret strings.

insights.title: Multi-model/provider routing
insights.notes: Route by quality, latency, cost, privacy, jurisdiction, availability and user entitlement.

insights.title: Agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration
insights.notes: Use bounded specialist agents with durable execution, scopes, approvals and result verification.

insights.title: RAG, embeddings and vector retrieval
insights.notes: Ground responses in canonical Pantavion data with provenance and access controls.

insights.title: Memory, state and automation
insights.notes: Per-user consent-aware memory plus persistent workflows/checkpoints.

insights.title: AI security, guardrails, evals and observability
insights.notes: Evidence-first tracing, evaluation, policy gates, anomaly monitoring and audit.

insights.title: MCP/tool interoperability
insights.notes: Adopt only authorized connectors/tools behind permission and audit boundaries.

insights.title: Inference optimization workstream
insights.notes: Apply only to self-hosted/model-serving infrastructure after benchmarks; do not fake when using external APIs.

insights.title: LLM fundamentals knowledge map
insights.notes: Use as educational/reference material, not as proof Pantavion trains a foundation model.

insights.title: Data and AI engineering completeness map
insights.notes: Use for PantaLearn curriculum and engineering completeness audits.

insights.title: External learning/research source intake
insights.notes: Verify licensing, quality, privacy, current terms and provenance before inclusion/integration.

insights.title: Provider/tool economics registry
insights.notes: Time-sensitive free/paid claims must be re-verified; maintain current cost/limit registry.

insights.title: GEO / AI discoverability
insights.notes: Deliberate crawler policy, structured accessible content, provenance, freshness and measurable citations/referrals. Never fabricate authority.

insights.title: AI-assisted creator and commercial opportunities
insights.notes: Subject to IP, platform rules, consumer law, truth-in-advertising and no guaranteed-income claims.

insights.title: Executive-function specialist AI roles
insights.notes: Bounded advisory/workflow agents coordinated by orchestrator; no silent acquisition of human authority.
